onboarding.splashTitle: Say it. Keep your name out of it.
onboarding.splashSub: Anonymous notes for exchange students, at the events you're actually at.
onboarding.signUpSub: Two fields and you're nearly in.
onboarding.phoneHint: Optional. For the day you forget the one above.
onboarding.resetSent: Reset link sent, if the address exists
onboarding.errorEmailInUse: That email already has an account. Log in instead.
onboarding.errorCredentials: That email and password don't match.
onboarding.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.bioPlaceholder: Where you're from, what you're into
onboarding.photoHint: Real face, please. An admin checks it once.
onboarding.photoPermission: Allow photo access in your phone's settings to pick a picture.
onboarding.sectionHint: A tag, not a gatekeeper. Sections have no admins.
onboarding.pendingSub: An admin checks every profile by hand, so everyone here is real.
onboarding.stepReviewDesc: A person looks at your name and photo. No bots, no ghosts.
onboarding.stepInDesc: We send a notification. Then you can join events.
onboarding.pendingNote: We'll let you know. Nothing to do until then. You can close the app.
onboarding.rejectedNote: An admin didn't approve your profile. Edit it and send it again.
onboarding.approvedSub: Welcome in. Join your first event with a code or QR.
onboarding.coachTitle: Join an event to get started
onboarding.coachBody: Every event has a 6-character code and a QR at the door. Ask the organiser.

wall.title: Wall
wall.emptyOwner: Approved messages will show here. Approve one from your inbox.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: No messages yet. Join an event and see.

events.title: Events
events.empty: Nothing here yet. Events you join or create show up in this list.
events.name: Event name
events.approveFirstDesc: Posts to the room wait for you
events.postImmediatelyDesc: Posts go up as they come
events.codeHint: Ask the organiser, or scan the QR at the door.
events.codeNotFound: No event with that code. Check it with whoever shared it.
events.boardLive: The board is live. Say hi.
events.boardOpens: The board opens {date}. You'll see it in Upcoming until then.
events.scanHint: Camera · point at the event's QR
events.endAfterStart: End must be after the start.
events.multiDay: Multi-day. The board stays open the whole time.
events.oneNight: One night. Set the end on a later day for a multi-day event.
events.approveFirstLong: Posts to the room wait for you or a co-moderator before anyone sees them.
events.postImmediatelyLong: Posts go up as they come. You can still hide them.
events.onlyJoinedCanModerate: Only people who joined {name} can moderate it.
events.noOneJoined: No one by that name has joined.
events.modsNote: Co-moderators share the queue, can hide room posts, change board settings and close the board. Hidden identities stay private.
events.creator: Creator
events.modeWaits: Posts to the room wait for you.
events.modeImmediate: Posts go up as they come.
events.stillWaiting: The {n} already waiting still need a decision.
events.endsNote: The board closes itself at this time. Posts stay readable.
events.closeConfirmBody: No one can post after this. Everything already on the board stays readable.
events.closeConfirmBodyWaiting: No one can post after this, and the {n} waiting won't be published. Everything already on the board stays readable.

section.title: Section
section.note: A section is a tag people put on their profile. It has no admins and no board of its own.
section.tagNote: Sections are tags, not admins. Yours only shows where you're from.
section.noneFound: No section by that name. Pick the closest one; you can change it in Settings.

composer.sentToQueue: Sent. A moderator will release it.
composer.sentToInbox: Sent to their inbox. They decide if it goes public.
composer.screeningDetail: Our filter flagged it. You can still send; the server has the final say.
composer.goesToInbox: Goes to their inbox. They decide if it goes public.
composer.goesToInboxWall: Goes to {name}'s inbox first. They decide if it goes on their wall.
composer.approveFirstHint: This board approves posts first. A moderator will release it.
composer.noOneHere: No one by that name here.
composer.threadNote: Starts a private thread. Only the two of you see it. You can reveal yourself later, they can't make you.

thread.title: Thread
thread.empty: No threads yet. Reply privately to a post to start one.
thread.revealConfirm: Show your name and photo in this thread? You can't undo this.
thread.revealDesc: They see your name and photo. Can't be undone here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete everything? Your wall, inbox and threads go with it. No undo.

report.title: Report
report.sent: Reported. Only the admin sees who sent it.
report.threadNote: The whole thread goes to the admin. Only the admin sees who reported it.

eventFlow.requestError: Couldn’t load this. Check your connection and try again.
eventFlow.createError: Couldn’t create the event. Check the dates and try again.
eventFlow.archived: This board is closed. You can read, not post.
eventFlow.cameraPermission: Allow camera access to scan the event’s QR code.
eventFlow.cameraError: Couldn’t read the event code. Try another QR or enter the code instead.
eventFlow.noUpcoming: Nothing planned. Join with a code or create one.
eventFlow.noPeople: No joined members match your search.
eventFlow.joinedCount: {n} joined · everyone here was approved by an admin
eventFlow.opensAt: The board opens {date}. Until then, see who’s coming.
eventFlow.createdHelp: Share the code or QR. People who join land in People; the board opens at the start time.
eventFlow.codeHelp: Anyone with the code or QR can join.
eventFlow.shareMessage: Join {name} in [BRAND]. Enter this event code: {code}.

empty.private: Messages you keep private land here.

messageFlow.onWallNote: Your private inbox view of messages published on your wall.
messageFlow.namedOnly: This person accepts named messages only. Choose Named to send.
messageFlow.sendError: Couldn’t send this message. Check your connection and try again.
messageFlow.actionError: Couldn’t save that change. Try again.
messageFlow.deleteBody: It will be hidden from your inbox and wall. You can’t undo this. A report you filed will still be available to the admin.
messageFlow.blockBody: You won’t learn who an anonymous sender is. Their messages will be hidden from your inbox and wall, and they can’t write to you again. They won’t be notified.
messageFlow.blocked: Blocked. They can’t write to you again.

boardFlow.queueNote: Messages to a person go to their inbox and never enter this queue.
boardFlow.upcoming: The board opens when the event starts.
boardFlow.actionError: Couldn’t complete this action. Refresh and try again.
boardFlow.hideBody: Hide this post from the board? The content stays available for any report.
boardFlow.endRequired: Every event has an end time. Archived boards remain readable.

threadFlow.revealBody: They will see your name and photo from now on. Earlier messages stay as they were. This is permanent in this thread.
threadFlow.blockBody: They won’t be able to write to you again. This thread and their messages will be hidden for you. Their identity stays private, and they won’t be notified.
threadFlow.actionError: Couldn’t update this thread. Check your connection and try again.

settingsFlow.error: Couldn’t save that change. Check your connection and try again.
settingsFlow.legalPending: This document has not been published yet.
settingsFlow.anyone: Anyone at an event you joined can write to your inbox, anonymously or not.
settingsFlow.named_only: Only people showing their name can write to your inbox.
settingsFlow.nobody: Your inbox closes. Board posts and existing threads still work.
settingsFlow.futureOnly: Applies from now on. Messages already in your inbox stay.
settingsFlow.blockNote: Blocked people cannot write to you. Their existing messages and threads are hidden from you. They are not told; anonymous identities stay anonymous.
settingsFlow.mutedNote: Matching messages are delivered to Private without a push notification. Matching ignores case and Turkish diacritics. The sender is not told.
settingsFlow.pushNote: These preferences control push alerts. Delivery also depends on your device’s notification permission.
settingsFlow.languageNote: Changes app labels. What people wrote stays as written.
settingsFlow.sectionNote: You can change section once every 30 days. Your country changes with it. You stay approved and can keep using the app.
settingsFlow.sectionWait: You can change section again on {date}.
settingsFlow.sectionConfirm: Change to {name} · {country}? Your country follows this section. You stay approved. Your next section change will be available in 30 days.
settingsFlow.logoutBody: Your inbox, wall and threads stay. Log back in any time.
settingsFlow.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, profile, inbox, conversations and every post or message you sent, including copies on other people’s walls. This cannot be undone.
settingsFlow.deleteType: Type {word} to permanently delete your account.

notifications.threadsDesc: A reply in a private thread

reviewFlow.bannedBody: Your account cannot use the app. Contact the event organiser if you think this is a mistake.
